newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary NABI offer supplemented on strong demand.
newsitem.headline: Hungary NABI offer supplemented on strong demand.

text.p: An institutional offering in Hungarian busmaker NABI Rt closed on Tuesday 8.6 times oversubscribed, prompting the company's majority shareholder to raise the number of shares on sale, NABI said on Wednesday.

"As a result of the demand for the shares, The First Hungary Fund Limited... agreed to sell 200,000 existing shares as part of the institutional offering, in addition to the sale of 1,704,700 new shares by NABI Rt," NABI said in a statement.

"Subsequent to the institutional offering, a further 65,300 existing shares will be offered for sale by the First Hungary Fund Limited in a public offering to Hungarian institutional investors," it said.
The subscription price of the shares was set at 3,280 forints, the upper end of the originally set indicative price range of 2,850 to 3,280 forints.
As a result of the combined offering, the Fund's shareholding in the company will be reduced to approximately 56 percent.

Subscriptions in the public offer will run from July 21 to 23, after which the shares will be listed to the "B" category of the Budapest Stock Exchange. NABI has already lodged its request to the bourse to list its shares.
